items.summary: Security disposition: evidence_needed for fleet-wide clearance; blocked for security-sensitive public exposure; conditional for ordinary reversible growth. Evidence: fleet-doctor has no run or results; operations deploy, uptime, and error sweeps are unavailable; authentication boundaries, least privilege, secrets handling, container isolation, release approvals, dependency provenance, data exposure, monitoring, incident response, TLS coverage, and security.txt/disclosure readiness remain unverified. No certificates are reported expiring within 30 days, but this does not establish complete TLS posture. Compliance is a technical baseline only: 37 pass, 16 fail, and 6 unknown. Retained worker and reviewer failures are containment signals, not evidence of compromise. Risk severity is high for public exposure and security-sensitive release, medium for bounded growth. Exact decision: keep private launch gates unchanged; continue existing bounded read-only security evidence work; permit only reversible growth that adds no credentials, permissions, dependencies, data collection, or cross-site behavior. Do not create duplicate work, requeue failures, modify production, access credentials or private containers, exploit targets, or conduct external outreach.

Continue the existing consolidated read-only security evidence work only. Record dated evidence, owners, affected scope, explicit unknowns, severity, and release implications for authentication, secrets, isolation, release controls, dependencies, TLS, data exposure, monitoring, incident handling, and disclosure readiness. Do not create duplicate work items or proposals.
